about.title: About
about.subtitle: Game Streaming Service for Windows
about.description_html: Windows service that creates and manages isolated sessions for game streaming with Sunshine and Moonlight, and local seats so several people can use the same PC at once. Everything is controlled from a web interface or REST API.
about.feat1.title: Isolated RDP sessions
about.feat1.desc: Each session runs under its own Windows user with an independent Sunshine
about.feat2.title: Independent stream profile
about.feat2.desc: Runs stream apps with their own Windows profile paths
about.feat3.title: Tray icon
about.feat3.desc: Quick session control from the Windows notification area
about.feat4.title: Auto-start and monitoring
about.feat4.desc: Enabled sessions are relaunched automatically and monitored every 5 s
about.credit.freerdp: RDP client used to create the stream session
about.credit.vigem: Virtual gamepad driver for the remote controller
about.credit.hidhide: Isolates each gamepad in its Windows session
about.credit.termwrap: Enables several simultaneous RDP sessions on client editions of Windows, Home included, and lets RemoteIdd plug into RDP.

rdp.title: Multi-session RDP (TermWrap)
rdp.description: OpenStreamMS uses TermWrap (llccd) to allow several simultaneous RDP sessions on Windows editions that normally allow only one, Home included. TermWrap 0.7 is downloaded from github.com/llccd/TermWrap, checked against a fixed hash and installed in %ProgramFiles%\RDP Wrapper. OpenStreamMS checks it at every start and puts it back if Windows or another tool changes it.
rdp.log.title: Operation log
rdp.log.empty: No operation has been run in this session.
rdp.confirm.install:
Install or repair TermWrap?
It is downloaded if missing and TermService is restarted when no RDP session is open; otherwise it takes effect after restarting Windows.
vigem.title: ViGEmBus (virtual gamepad driver)
vigem.description: ViGEmBus is the virtual gamepad driver used by Sunshine to translate the remote controller into a local Xbox/DualShock pad. The installer is downloaded from github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus and run silently.
vigem.log.title: Operation log
vigem.log.empty: No operation has been run in this session.
vigem.rebootRequired: ⚠ Reboot required to complete the operation.
vigem.confirm.install:
Install or upgrade ViGEmBus?
The latest release from nefarius/ViGEmBus will be downloaded and the signed driver installed silently. No running stream will be affected.
vigem.confirm.uninstall:
Uninstall ViGEmBus?
Moonlight clients will stop being able to use their gamepad until the driver is reinstalled. A reboot may be required.
hidhide.title: HidHide (gamepad isolation)
hidhide.description: HidHide hides each gamepad from the other Windows sessions: virtual pads are only visible in their stream session and physical pads only on the host. It is installed together with OpenStreamMS; the installer is run silently.
hidhide.confirm.install:
Install or upgrade HidHide?
The signed driver will be installed silently. A reboot may be required.
hidhide.confirm.uninstall:
Uninstall HidHide?
Gamepads will be visible (and usable) from every session again. A reboot may be required.

guide.heading: OpenStreamMS guide
guide.welcome.title: One PC, several people playing
guide.welcome.lead: OpenStreamMS shares this PC between several people at once. There are two ways to use it: sessions, played from another device, and seats, played right here.
guide.welcome.sessions: Play from your TV, laptop or phone over the network.
guide.welcome.seats: Play on this PC with another monitor, keyboard and gamepad.
guide.session.title: What is a session?
guide.session.lead: A session is a Windows desktop that runs on this PC and is streamed to another device. Each session is independent: several can run at the same time.
guide.session.p1: Each session can have an isolated user, with its own files and settings, or use the PC's own desktop.
guide.session.p2: Each session has a streaming server with its own ports, resolution and apps.
guide.session.p3: With Moonlight (PC, phone, console) or from a browser or TV over WebRTC.
guide.session.p4: It can start with Windows; OpenStreamMS watches it and restarts it if it stops.
guide.seat.title: What is a seat?
guide.seat.lead: A seat is a physical spot at this PC: a monitor, keyboard, mouse, gamepad and audio output that a session is assigned to. It is used as if it were another computer.
guide.seat.p1: A seat's devices only control its session; assign them by dragging them in the Seats tab.
guide.seat.p2: The picture goes straight to the seat's monitor, uncompressed and with very low latency.
guide.seat.p3: A monitor can be one whole seat or be split into halves or quarters.
guide.seat.cmpSession: Played on another device, over the network.
guide.seat.cmpSeat: Played here, with peripherals plugged into this PC. Each seat uses a session.
guide.install.title: What you need to install
guide.install.lead: These components are installed only once. Their status updates by itself while the guide is open.
guide.install.rdp: Allows several Windows sessions at once, Windows Home included.
guide.install.vigem: Creates the virtual gamepads used by remote controllers.
guide.install.hidhide: Makes each physical gamepad visible only to its own session.
guide.install.remoteidd: A dedicated display for seat sessions. Experimental; installed by ticking its option in the installer.
guide.start.title: All set to start!
guide.start.lead: Create what you need. You can come back to this guide at any time from the "?" button at the top.
guide.start.session: Create a session, start it and connect with Moonlight or from your TV.
guide.start.seat: Plug in another monitor and peripherals, and create a seat with them.
guide.start.connect: To connect, press "Connect" on the session's card: you will see the address and where to type the Moonlight PIN.
